note: D2 marker facts for the PLE-venue experiment. All proper nouns are invented compounds; each carries a nonce number to force unseen n-grams (contamination risk of common words is why marker tokens are never dictionary words). marker_texts are the ALIASES written into the table; fact_text is the sentence whose rows16 are cloned onto them; controls are alias-shaped sentences NEVER written (negative controls - a correct answer there means guessing, not memory). Questions for the probes are built by run_probes.py from these fields.
